pairs: do not be silent toward me.
For if you remain silent toward me,
I will become like those who descend into the pit.
vocem deprecationis meæ dum oro ad te;
the voice of my supplication, when I pray to you,
dum extollo manus meas ad templum sanctum tuum.
when I lift up my hands toward your holy temple.
Ne simul trahas me cum peccatoribus,
Do not draw me away together with sinners;
et cum operantibus iniquitatem ne perdas me;
and let me not perish with those who work iniquity,
qui loquuntur pacem cum proximo suo,
who speak peacefully to their neighbor,
yet evils are in their hearts.
Give to them according to their works
and according to the wickedness of their inventions.
Secundum opera manuum eorum tribue illis;
Assign to them according to the works of their hands.
Repay them with their own retribution.
Since they have not understood the works of the Lord and the works of his hands,
et in opera manuum ejus destrues illos,
and you will not build them up.
for he has heard the voice of my supplication.
The Lord is my helper and my protector.
my heart has hoped and I have been helped.
And my flesh has flourished again.
et ex voluntate mea confitebor ei.
The Lord is the strength of his people
et protector salvationum christi sui est.
and the protector of the salvation of his Christ.
O Lord, save your people and bless your inheritance,
et benedic hæreditati tuæ; et rege eos,
and reign over them and exalt them,
et extolle illos usque in æternum.
